details: The crypto market is experiencing mixed signals, with Bitcoin trading around $77,590, up slightly by 0.12% in the last 24 hours, despite a minor 0.44% dip in the global market cap. Ethereum is near $2,315. Over $10 billion in options on Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Solana are set to expire, contributing to market uncertainty alongside geopolitical tensions. However, strong underlying bullish indicators persist: Bitcoin whales have accumulated $3.17 billion in BTC since April 10, and Bitcoin ETFs have seen a nine-day inflow streak totaling $2.12 billion. Ethereum NFT trading volume also surged by 72% in the past 24 hours. Analysts are closely watching the $80,000 level for Bitcoin as a potential catalyst for further price increases.
title: Crypto Markets Show Mixed Signals as ETF Inflows and Whale Accumulation Continue Amid Options Expiry

details: Tether, a prominent stablecoin issuer, has frozen $344 million in cryptocurrency in connection with an ongoing investigation by U.S. authorities. This action highlights increasing regulatory scrutiny on stablecoin operations and their potential impact on the broader crypto ecosystem.
title: Tether Freezes $344 Million in Crypto Amid US Investigation
